An https image URL is extracted into metadata.images when extract_metadata is true

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p><img src="https://example.com/photo.jpg" alt="A photo"></p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.metadata.images.inspect
```
